introBody: Discover fictional Nepali businesses, examine the evidence, and practice owning a small part of their story.
introDetail: Virtual funds cannot be bought, withdrawn, redeemed, or converted into securities.
welcome: A little curiosity. A bigger tomorrow.
welcomeBody: Meet the people building Nepal, one idea at a time. Practice investing with virtual funds.
defaultOrder: Default order: curated fictional stories. This is not an investment recommendation.
emptyBody: Explore a business or try another filter.
name: Your name
authBody: Your simulation starts with an adult account and verified email.
verifySent: Verification email sent. Open the local mail viewer in development, then paste its token here.
verified: Email verified. You can sign in now.
resetSent: If this account exists, password reset instructions have been sent.
accountRequired: Sign in to save, simulate, or manage your account.
quoteInfo: The server rechecks funds, terms, and remaining capacity when you confirm.
riskAck: I understand that a real equity investment could lose all its value, be diluted, and have no ready resale market.
simulationAck: I understand this is nonbinding simulation with no real money or securities.
pending: Pending allocation. Shares are issued only after an authorized successful round close.
uncertain: The result is uncertain. Check activity or retry this same request; its key prevents duplication.
dilution: Ownership can be diluted by future share issuance. There is no guaranteed dividend or ready resale market.
noMoney: Virtual funds have no cash value and cannot be purchased, withdrawn, or redeemed.
cancelled: Commitment cancelled; funds released by the server.
atCost: Shown at cost. No invented market prices or daily gains.
learningBody: A few clear ideas to help you ask better questions.
equityBody: Equity is ownership in a business. It is not a loan and does not promise fixed interest.
dilutionBody: When a company issues more shares, your percentage can fall unless you participate. Future terms matter.
valuationBody: A valuation is a negotiated price for a business. Forecasts are conditional scenarios, not guarantees.
riskBody: A business can fail. Dividends may never be paid and you may be unable to sell your shares.
question: Does equity guarantee a dividend?
correct: Correct. Dividends depend on business decisions and available funds.
incorrect: Try again. Owning shares does not guarantee a dividend.
adult: I confirm I am at least 18 years old
acceptTerms: I agree to the simulation terms
ownerBody: Build a fictional business story and follow its human review.
uploadNotice: Use fictional sample files only. Never upload real identity cards, PAN records, or bank statements.
processing: Uploaded into quarantine. Review access requires a clean scan.
title: Title
guidelines: I confirm this update is fictional, respectful, and contains no sensitive personal information.
deleteBody: Request deletion of this account. Active commitments are handled by the server; session access is revoked when deletion completes.
privacyBody: This demo stores account details, fictional business submissions, virtual ledger entries, preferences, and support requests. Do not upload real personal documents. Secure storage holds your session token. Public business data may be cached; private documents are not cached. No advertising or analytics SDK is included.
projectionNote: Scenarios are illustrations, not probability estimates. Profit differs from cash flow.
pushStatus: Push provider is unconfigured. Your in-app inbox remains available.
termsFrozen: Published round terms are frozen. Material changes require cancellation/refund before replacement.
